title: Panels System Step 06 - Populate Panel Shell Section
objectives: Populate 'Panel Shell' section of /design-system page with V9PanelShell demos
Show V9PanelShell in both full mode and strip mode
Demonstrate panel states (active, inactive) and interactions (drag, close)
Verify that PanelShell and V9PanelShell work correctly in design system context
invariants: Skin/Theme: All styles must pass through wanderlustTokens.css, use CSS classes instead of inline styles
Localization: All user-facing strings must use useTranslation with common or idleVillage namespace
Component Reuse: Use existing V9PanelShell component, do not duplicate markup
State Management: Panel state managed by usePanelsStore (Zustand), not Context
Config-first: No hardcoded values, use wanderlustTokens CSS variables

operations.description: Replace placeholder content in 'Shell' section with actual V9PanelShell demos
Add demo panel in full mode showing basic V9PanelShell with sample content
Add demo panel in strip/compact mode showing collapsed V9PanelShell
Add demo showing active vs inactive panel states with visual differences
Add controls to toggle between full and strip modes for shell demos
Ensure all user-facing strings use useTranslation with appropriate namespace
Wrap shell demos in DndContext to enable drag functionality

guardrails: DO NOT create new panel components - use existing V9PanelShell
DO NOT add hardcoded CSS - use wanderlustTokens.css classes
DO NOT bypass usePanelsStore - panel state must come from Zustand store
DO NOT add inline user-facing strings - all must use useTranslation
Maintain existing Panels section functionality while adding Shell section
acceptance_criteria: Shell section shows V9PanelShell in full mode with sample content
Shell section shows V9PanelShell in strip/compact mode
Active and inactive panel states are visually distinguishable
Drag functionality works in shell demos
Close button functionality works in shell demos
No hardcoded CSS or values - all use wanderlustTokens
Design system page renders without errors
notes: The Shell section currently shows only placeholder 'Work in progress'. This step should replace that with actual working demos of V9PanelShell showing different modes and states. Use existing panel store state or create demo panels specifically for the shell section.
